reviews.title: Overall, pretty good.
reviews.text: The breakfast was good, and the dinner there was also very good.  The staff was very courteous and helpful, and our Cleaning Service for our room was outstanding. / We have stayed in Fairmont Hotels in other places, i.e. San Franciso, and we have always had an excellent experience.  I felt this property seemed a "little tired" and could use some sprucing up.  Considering the expensive nightly cost of the hotel, and the expensive cost of every dinner and also the spa - where I paid $300.00 for a Facial - I would expect everything to be excellent.  As an example, we had a first floor room in I Building, and the sliding wooden door would not open all the way.  We called the second day of our 4-day stay there to have it fixed, yet it was not fixed and we did not get another contact from your Facilities Team.  It wasn't a major thing because we didn't stay in the room that much, but I would expect more from a 5-star Fairmont Hotel.  Overall, we had a good time, but again for the price, we expected a little more.  I would have to think about staying in this hotel again, and would first try some other 5-star hotels in the area.
reviews.author: Samuel
